result:
The decisive mistake was WebSurfer's click at step 20. The step 16 search results included the official Fubo governance page (ir.fubo.tv/governance, "Management Team"). WebSurfer instead opened Jonathan Luftman's LinkedIn profile. He is not a member of the management team, and the profile was behind a login wall. From there the team never reached the management team list and ran out of time without an answer.

AGENT: WebSurfer
STEP: 20
